title: eludite.workspace.exclude input
description: Exclude From Project: the host removes the files or folders from their project without deleting them (eludite/project/editItems exclude): an SDK project gets a `Remove` for a globbed item or loses the explicit element, a legacy project loses the element. The tree is refreshed; with Show All Files they stay visible, muted.

paths.description: Absolute paths, or relative to the workspace folder.
